subject: general
question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

The numbers 1 to 6 represents the years from 2001 to 2006. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de442289567de558cbbce347ac6d9594c23464f45f7847a818242ac88a3338a0.png] 

In which year was the difference between the production of two companies maximum?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Difference between the production of two companies in 2001 = 139 - 119 = 20

Difference between the production of two companies in 2002 = 120 - 99 = 21

Difference between the production of two companies in 2003 = 141 - 100 = 41

Difference between the production of two companies in 2004 = 128 - 78 = 50

Difference between the production of two companies in 2005 = 120 - 107 = 13

Difference between the production of two companies in 2006 = 159 - 148 = 11

**∴ Difference between the production of two companies was maximum in 2004.**
